name: Chris Simon
bio: Chris is a technology coach and advisor helping technology teams drive business success, from startups realising their vision to new CTOs finding their feet. He launched Contextive and co-founded DDD Australia and the ADAConf conference.

name: Seb Rose
bio: Seb has been a consultant, coach, designer, author and developer for over 40 years, at companies large and small. He is co-author of Effective Behaviour-Driven Development and lead author of The Cucumber for Java Book.

name: Gáspár Nagy
bio: Gáspár is the creator of SpecFlow and Reqnroll, with over 20 years as a coach, trainer and test automation expert through his company Spec Solutions. He co-authored Discovery, Formulation and Effective Behavior-Driven Development.

name: Trond Hjorteland
role: Senior IT consultant and sociotechnical practitioner
bio: Trond is an IT architect and open sociotechnical systems practitioner working on large, complex, business-critical systems in telecom, media, TV and the public sector. His mantra: great solutions emerge from collaborative sense-making and design.

name: Gien Verschatse
bio: Gien is a consultant and software engineer specialising in domain modelling and software architecture, fluent in both object-oriented and functional programming. She researches the science of decision-making, to help teams improve how they decide.

name: Gitte Klitgaard
bio: Gitte is an agile coach with more than a decade of experience working with companies and coaching individuals. She wants to change the world by helping people work better together and feel better about themselves; her main tools are listening and caring.

name: Alexander Thurow
role: Freelance software developer, consultant and speaker
bio: Alex is a freelance software developer, consultant and speaker based in Überlingen, Germany, with over 20 years in the industry. His main areas of interest are clean code, refactoring, technical debt and knowledge transfer.

name: Matteo Collina
bio: Matteo is a long-time Node.js contributor and a member of its Technical Steering Committee.
